title: Introduce ChatUI project, session membership, and ownership boundaries
description: AstrBot dashboard has ChatUI project routes for project CRUD, session membership, and per-user ownership checks. Existing Rust conversation/storage tasks cover history, but do not capture project membership and ownership as a separate domain.

files.change: Define project metadata, ownership policy, and project/session DTOs outside web handlers.
Add repository traits for project CRUD and session membership independent from conversation message history.
Route project operations through domain/storage ports with explicit creator ownership checks.

criteria: Project CRUD and session membership do not depend on WebChat transport routes.
Ownership checks are expressed as domain policy, not repeated route conditionals.
Conversation history storage stays separate from project membership storage.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-storage && cargo test -p astrbot-web && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
